Ben Affleck put rumors to rest after years of speculation about a specific scene in one of his dozens of movie roles.

Affleck, 54, confirmed he showed all of his own skin in the 2014 psychological thriller "Gone Girl."

In the David Fincher film based on Gillian Flynn's 2012 novel, Affleck appeared completely in the nude for a shower scene.

Ben Affleck starred as Nick Dunne in the psychological thriller released in 2014. (Gonzalo)

"I wore no prosthesis," he said during a sit-down with Variety.

Affleck added, "I've only worn one in one film, 'Hollywoodland.' It was a nose."

The Oscar winner starred as writing teacher Nick Dunne, who becomes a prime suspect following the disappearance of his wife, Amy, played by Rosamund Pike.

Affleck previously discussed the director's vision while filming the scene, and admitted he was "assured" nothing would be shown to audiences.

Ben Affleck starred alongside Rosamund Pike in David Fincher's "Gone Girl." (Dimitrios Kambouris)

He also joked, "I’d like to thank you for keeping the set cool ... If you’re gonna have one chance for America to see your junk, you want it to be cold."

While reflecting on the impact of the film more than a decade later, Affleck told Letterboxd, "I was willing to do anything for [Fincher], like, be naked."
